systems.name: Business Management System
systems.desc: An all-in-one system combining customer relationship management with inventory tracking — built as a flexible base we customize per client.

systems.name: Restaurant Management System
systems.desc: Next in our systems line — order tracking, inventory, and staff scheduling built for restaurants and food service businesses.

systems.name: License Server
systems.desc: An ASP.NET licensing service with a companion C# client library for WinForms apps. Supports Admin, Manager, and Staff roles, and can onboard any new app by registering it and issuing an app ID used to verify licenses.

systems.name: Licensed Browser Wrapper Template
systems.desc: An in-house C# WinForms template for building browser-wrapper desktop apps with licensing already integrated — the base we build our desktop products on.

systems.name: Static Site + Content Manager Template
systems.tagline: GitHub Pages site with a JSON-driven updater app
systems.desc: A reusable template pairing a static site — hosted on GitHub Pages, content driven entirely by a JSON file — with a companion desktop app that updates that JSON. This same system powers this site.

projects.title: Ajyal Assistant
projects.desc: Desktop app for Jordanian public schools and the stationery stores that work with them. Scrapes school data from the Ministry of Education's EMIS portal and uses it to fill Excel templates, generating attendance records, marks records, and certificates.
highlights: Pulls data directly from Jordan's MOE EMIS portal (ajyal.moe.gov.jo/emis)
Generates attendance records, marks records, and certificates by filling Excel templates
Used by both public schools and school-supply stores that serve them
Licensed app; no website or mobile version planned

projects.title: Mizan
projects.desc: Finance management system for Jordanian public school headmasters, also used by third parties who provide financial services to headmasters. Desktop app now, with website and/or mobile versions planned.
highlights: Built desktop-first for headmasters' daily use
Also used by external providers offering financial services to headmasters
Website and/or mobile versions planned, pending licensing arrangements
Licensed app

projects.title: Qalib
projects.desc: Free desktop tool that bulk-generates Excel files from a JSON array and a single Excel template, replacing {{tag}} placeholders with each record's data — including nested objects and lists of objects.
highlights: Supports nested objects ({{parent.child}}) and lists, including lists of objects ({{list[0].field}})
Preserves template formatting, merged cells, and formulas across every generated sheet
Runs 100% locally — no files are uploaded to any server
Free to use, with no license required

projects.title: Jadwalak
projects.desc: Desktop app that helps Jordanian public schools build and edit lecture timetables for their teaching staff.
highlights: Built for non-technical school staff to use directly
Handles the scheduling constraints specific to lecture timetabling
Website and/or mobile versions planned, pending licensing arrangements and further work on the scheduling algorithm
Licensed app

projects.title: Web-to-PDF Research Tool
projects.desc: Browser extension built for journalists to extract data from web pages into clean, reliable PDFs — solving inconsistent browser print output.
highlights: Extracts page data directly into a clean PDF layout
Solves the inconsistency of standard browser print-to-PDF
Built specifically around a journalist's research workflow

projects.title: Parental Control App
projects.desc: Mobile app for scheduling device usage windows and locking access with a PIN.
highlights: Scheduled device usage windows
PIN-based lock for restricted periods

projects.title: University Attendance System
projects.desc: Web-based attendance tracking system built with ASP.NET as a university project.
highlights: Built with ASP.NET
Digitizes attendance tracking for a university course
